note: sfx-kit-lite: curated subset of BnFactory/sfx-kit (opus-sound-layer). Rebuild: sfx_opus.py lite

hit.about: hero impact: cinematic hit, metal, punch, explosion

boom.about: sub drop, low boom under a hit

riser.about: tension build that peaks on the hit

reverse.about: reverse cymbal / suck-in that ends on the cue

swish.about: cloth, card slide, blade, small fast move

ui.about: interface blip: confirm, select, toggle, error, open

tap.about: light impact: glass, wood, metal, plastic, chip

shimmer.about: sparkle, magic, twinkle on a reveal
